note: The module catalogue the API serves at GET /api/modules. Titles, tiers, order and target exercise counts are the agreed curriculum baseline; the corpus in content/lessons and content/exercises is filed under these codes. A module with no lessons yet is declared here on purpose - the catalogue is wider than the corpus. M3 = Counting & Combinatorics holds m3-l1/m3-l2 (the counting lessons previously misfiled as m7-l1/m7-l2). M7 = Probability has no lessons authored yet.

modules.title: Algebra Foundations
modules.summary: Linear and quadratic equations, inequalities, absolute value, functional equations intro.

modules.title: Number Theory
modules.summary: Divisibility, modular arithmetic, CRT, gcd/lcm, base representation.

modules.title: Counting & Combinatorics
modules.summary: Permutations, combinations, inclusion-exclusion, recurrences, graph counting.

modules.title: Sequences & Series
modules.summary: Arithmetic and geometric, telescoping, sigma manipulation, series bounds.

modules.title: Geometry
modules.summary: Angles, circles, triangles, similar and congruent, area and volume, power of a point.

modules.title: Coordinate & Analytic Geometry
modules.summary: Distance and midpoint, lines, conics, loci, vectors, complex numbers viewed geometrically.

modules.title: Probability
modules.summary: Counting outcomes, conditional probability, Bayes, expectation, independence.

modules.title: Trigonometry
modules.summary: Identities, unit circle, law of sines and cosines, complex roots of unity, polar form.

modules.title: Precalculus & Proof Technique
modules.summary: Logs, AM-GM and Cauchy, Vieta, polynomial inequalities, olympiad proof patterns.
